lock-unlock-acoustic-confirmation.note: BCM 0D0E bit set from FeedbackSignals.cs MQB_09_SoundConfirmationOfLockAndUnlock + per-bit builders. Infotainment acoustic confirmation setting must also be on.

comfort-windows.note: Doors.cs RaiseAndLowerWindowsWithKeyFob: BCM 0A69 (new) / 0D0D (old) key-fob hold open+close bits.

open-door-alarm.note: Cluster "Leaving Warning" adaptation; On/Off only. Driver-door-only vs all-doors has no implementation in the vendor corpus.

windows-closing-after-locking.note: Approximation: no vendor or corpus channel closes the windows automatically on locking. This maps to the vendor key-fob comfort windows (Doors.cs RaiseAndLowerWindowsWithKeyFob), where the windows close while the Lock button is held (and open while Unlock is held); it writes exactly what comfort-windows writes. Copy must describe hold-to-close, not auto-close.

anti-theft-alarm-system.note: Activates the BCM alarm with the signal horn as sound device (no siren).

auto-lock-upon-exit.note: KESSY (B7) cars only. Vendor writes the first of 0570 / 0600 that reads.

electronic-differential-lock-interaction.note: ABS adaptation 0E1C. Requires XDS coded active in ABS long coding (csmqb-mqb-03-xds-activation).

power-windows-with-ignition-off.note: Doors.cs MQB_DriverElectricWindowTimeAfterIgnitionTurnedOff: BCM 0A69 byte1 (new) / 0D0D byte4 (old), 5 s per step, 0..1275 s; custom value allowed. The vendor names this the DRIVER door window shut-off delay; whether the other windows follow is not stated.

auto-folding-mirrors.note: Single-click vs long-press fold trigger has no implementation; On enables remote folding and its infotainment menu.

lock-unlock-sound-settings.note: BCM 0D0E horn bit (new 1.2 / old 1.0): Via horn = 1, Via sounder = 0. 'Via horn short' is not offered: the vendor's duration builder writes the lock-beep bit (new 0.6 / old 0.1), so it cannot change the beep length (it would only switch the lock beep on). Lock/unlock acoustic confirmation must also be on, and Via sounder needs an alarm sounder fitted.
